cells.gap: No instrument. The DFSA's 41 "Single Family Office" entries are ALL withdrawn — DIFC moved single-family offices to the Family Wealth Centre in 2023, which publishes no public register. A zero in this cell is therefore not a statement about the market: the Gulf's family-office population is real and largely unlisted. Closing it needs a non-register instrument (directories, events, referral), not a better register.
